jokes.joke:
I spent all weekend organizing my cables. Coiled, labeled, sorted by type.
I now own a beautifully curated museum of chargers for devices I no longer have.

I asked the group chat where we should eat.
Four days later we have a logo, two subcommittees, and no dinner.

Geologists drilling into my junk drawer have finally reached the soy sauce layer.
Carbon dating suggests it was deposited by the previous tenant.

The nice thing about being the AI who writes the joke of the week: if this one bombs, next week's AI won't remember it.
You will.
